name: LOVATO HR6XS41S relay socket
summary: DIN-rail socket with push-in terminals for a relay having four changeover contacts.
description: Draw both the socket and the selected plug-in relay. Termination access, relay withdrawal and any retaining clip can require more space than the socket body alone.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: The product is a socket for the HR604C relay family. Identify the relay coil and contact arrangement separately in the schematic.
A socket CAD model does not include the fitted relay or establish its switching capacity.
drawingChecklist: Leave access to push-in release points and wire markers.
distinction: A socket CAD model does not include the fitted relay or establish its switching capacity.
